messages.author: 66d6ed8993e172a4
messages.subject: MSstats 4.1.1 changes
parts:
Hi all,

Love all the work that you all do for this package!
 
After the course at ASMS, I've been trying to learn how to use it and I've noticed that some output has changed. I've been following this tutorial https://msstats.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/MSstats_v3.18.1_manual_2020Feb26-v2.pdf. However, using the inbuilt data `DDARawData` gives me a different result from what's in the tutorial.
In particular, I'm referring to the output of `dataProcess()` which now only has Protein and Features level data. Attached here is the code that I ran. This is probably because of a new version of `MSstats`.

`DDA2009.proposed <- dataProcess(raw = DDARawData,
normalization = 'equalizeMedians',
summaryMethod = 'TMP',
censoredInt = "NA",
MBimpute = TRUE,
maxQuantileforCensored=0.999)
`

`names(DDA2009.proposed)`
`## [1] "FeatureLevelData" "ProteinLevelData" "SummaryMethod"`

Could you suggest how to run the differential expression results in this new situation? Or do you have a new tutorial that described the changes?

Thanks a lot,

Anna
